vulnerability_policy.policy: No unreviewed CRITICAL vulnerabilities; any unpatched CRITICAL must have a non-expired, CVE/package-specific not_affected VEX rationale. Any CRITICAL with a published fix fails. No HIGH vulnerabilities when a fixed version is available. Unfixed HIGH findings are recorded for review but do not fail this demonstration gate.

covered_critical_findings.impact_statement: The issue requires compiling an extreme Perl regular expression. The shadow scoring service executes Python/FastAPI only and has no subprocess or Perl execution path. Re-review is mandatory at VEX expiry or when Debian publishes a stable fix.

The issue concerns Perl Archive::Tar extraction of attacker-controlled links. The shadow scoring service does not invoke Perl or Archive::Tar and does not extract user-supplied archives. Re-review is mandatory at VEX expiry or when Debian publishes a stable fix.

The Debian/Perl issue is documented for 32-bit builds. The validated runtime image is linux/amd64 and the FastAPI service does not invoke Perl. Re-review is mandatory at VEX expiry or when Debian publishes a stable fix.

security_boundary: This gate reports vulnerabilities visible to the scanner at build time and uses explicit, time-limited exploitability review for unpatched critical findings. It is not a claim that the image is vulnerability-free, permanently secure, or approved for production pricing.
